book_title: The Emergence of Iranian Nationalism: Race and the Politics of Dislocation
author: Zia Ebrahimi
body_text:

The origin of the Aryan myth is usually associated with

Sir William Jones’s discovery in 1786 that Greek, Latin,
Sanskrit. and Persian derived from common roots.
